segments.source: În același an întâlni din nou pe Deli. Ea conducea acum o echipă de reparații și avea două degete deformate de la o infecție netratată. Academia îi oferise acces medical odată cu invitația, dar pierduse dreptul când familia refuzase.
segments.translation: That same year, he met Deli again. She now led a repair team and had two fingers deformed by an untreated infection. The academy had offered medical access with its invitation, but she had lost that right when her family declined.

segments.source: — Puteai să vii, spuse Sen.
segments.translation: “You could have come,” Sen said.

segments.source: — Și cine curăța canalele?
segments.translation: “And who would have cleaned the channels?”

segments.source: — Ar fi găsit pe altcineva.
segments.translation: “They would have found someone else.”

segments.source: — Exact.
segments.translation: “Exactly.”

segments.source: El nu înțelese imediat. Pentru el, a fi înlocuibil era o insultă. Pentru Deli, era motivul pentru care instituțiile puteau cere sacrificiul fără să-l numere.
segments.translation: He did not understand at once. To him, being replaceable was an insult. To Deli, it was the reason institutions could demand sacrifice without counting it.

segments.source: Sen îi obținu operația prin fondul Custodiei. Ea acceptă și refuză apoi locul oferit în administrație.
segments.translation: Sen secured her operation through the Custodianship fund. She accepted, then refused the administrative position she was offered.

segments.source: — Nu vreau să fiu povestea ta bună, spuse.
segments.translation: “I do not want to be your good story,” she said.

segments.source: — Nu este poveste. Este tratament.
segments.translation: “It is not a story. It is treatment.”

segments.source: — Atunci lasă-l să rămână atât.
segments.translation: “Then let it remain that.”

segments.source: Nemi păstră incidentul numai în dosarul medical, la cererea ei. Era una dintre rarele situații în care arhiva devenea mai adevărată prin ceea ce refuza să transforme în simbol.
segments.translation: At her request, Nemi kept the incident only in the medical file. It was one of the rare occasions when the archive became truer through what it refused to turn into a symbol.

segments.source: La cincisprezece ani, Sen ucise primul comandant rebel. Revolta avusese loc într-un oraș termic de la marginea Zilei. Mâinile preluaseră instalația după ce administratorii Feței reducuseră cotele de apă. Custodia negocia de două săptămâni. În a treia, rebelii capturară un tren și omorâră doi paznici.
segments.translation: At fifteen, Sen killed his first rebel commander. The revolt had taken place in a thermal city at the edge of Day. The Hands had seized the facility after the Face administrators reduced the water quotas. The Custodianship had been negotiating for two weeks. In the third, the rebels captured a train and killed two guards.

segments.source: Sen conduse echipa care intră prin conducta de răcire. Îl găsi pe comandant, o femeie numită Iara, lângă panoul reactorului. Ea avea arma jos. În spate, un dispozitiv număra până la supraîncălzire.
segments.translation: Sen led the team that entered through the cooling pipe. He found the commander, a woman named Iara, beside the reactor panel. Her weapon was lowered. Behind her, a device was counting down to overheating.

segments.source: — Oprește-l, spuse Sen.
segments.translation: “Stop it,” Sen said.

segments.source: — Deschide apa pentru cartier.
segments.translation: “Turn on the district’s water.”

segments.source: — Nu pot de aici.
segments.translation: “I cannot do that from here.”

segments.source: — Atunci cheamă pe cine poate.
segments.translation: “Then call someone who can.”

segments.source: Timpul scădea. Sen putea trage în mână, dar Iara ținea comanda tactilă pe detonator. Putea negocia și risca reactorul. A împușcat-o în cap. Corpul căzu fără să elibereze mecanismul. Un tehnician opri secvența cu șapte secunde înainte de avarie.
segments.translation: Time was running out. Sen could shoot her hand, but Iara held the touch control on the detonator. He could negotiate and risk the reactor. He shot her in the head. Her body fell without releasing the mechanism. A technician stopped the sequence seven seconds before failure.

segments.source: Custodia declară intervenția exemplară. Orașul primi apă după trei zile, în urma unei anchete care confirmă că reducerile fuseseră excesive. Sen participă la înmormântarea Iarei fără însemne. Familia ei îi ceru să plece.
segments.translation: The Custodianship declared the intervention exemplary. The city received water three days later, following an investigation that confirmed the cuts had been excessive. Sen attended Iara’s funeral without insignia. Her family asked him to leave.

segments.source: — Am oprit reactorul, spuse el Vessei după întoarcere.
segments.translation: “I stopped the reactor,” he told Vessa after returning.

segments.source: — Da.
segments.translation: “Yes.”

segments.source: — Dacă așteptam, mureau mii.
segments.translation: “If I had waited, thousands would have died.”

segments.source: — Poate.
segments.translation: “Perhaps.”

segments.source: — Nu-mi spune ca Nemi.
segments.translation: “Do not talk like Nemi.”

segments.source: — Ce vrei să-ți spun?
segments.translation: “What do you want me to say?”

segments.source: — Că am făcut bine.
segments.translation: “That I did the right thing.”

segments.source: Vessa îi examină pupilele și pulsul. Băiatul nu dormise de două cicluri.
segments.translation: Vessa examined his pupils and pulse. The boy had not slept for two cycles.

segments.source: — Ai făcut o alegere defensabilă într-o situație construită prost de mulți oameni. Dacă o numim pur și simplu bună, toți ceilalți dispar.
segments.translation: “You made a defensible choice in a situation badly constructed by many people. If we simply call it good, everyone else disappears.”

segments.source: — Tata ar fi tras.
segments.translation: “Father would have fired.”

segments.source: — Probabil.
segments.translation: “Probably.”

segments.source: — Atunci de ce lui îi spuneți că a salvat lumea?
segments.translation: “Then why do you tell him he saved the world?”

segments.source: — Eu nu-i spun asta.
segments.translation: “I do not tell him that.”

segments.source: Sen plecă furios. În noaptea aceea, urmă de nouă ori înregistrarea. Nu momentul focului, ci cele șapte secunde după, când tehnicianul alerga spre panou. A doua zi ceru ca raportul să-i menționeze numele. Tehnicianul deveni cunoscut. Iara rămase „comandant rebel”.
segments.translation: Sen left angry. That night, he watched the recording nine times. Not the shot, but the seven seconds afterwards, when the technician ran towards the panel. The next day, he asked for the report to mention the technician’s name. The technician became known. Iara remained “rebel commander”.

segments.source: La șaisprezece ani, Sen avea trei copii cu două partenere. Biologia nivarilor făcea posibilă maturitatea timpurie, iar cultura Feței o transforma în datorie. Familiile aleseseră embrionii după compatibilitate, sănătate și aceleași trăsături pe care clinicile le numeau stabilitate. Sen spusese că nu voia selecție. Acceptase însă variantele recomandate de medici, iar recomandările fuseseră construite din succesul generației lui.
segments.translation: At sixteen, Sen had three children with two partners. Nivar biology made early maturity possible, and Face culture turned it into a duty. The families had chosen the embryos for compatibility, health and the same traits the clinics called stability. Sen had said he did not want selection. Yet he had accepted the variants recommended by the doctors, and those recommendations had been built from his generation’s success.

segments.source: Vessa examina copiii. Unul avea o malformație minoră a auzului, asociată cu combinarea markerilor de densitate osoasă. Altul nu reacționa la sunetele de alarmă și primea deja laude pentru calm.
segments.translation: Vessa examined the children. One had a minor hearing malformation associated with the combination of bone-density markers. Another did not react to alarm sounds and was already being praised for calmness.

segments.source: — Nu-l testați ca pe o Feță, le spuse părinților.
segments.translation: “Do not test him like a Face,” she told the parents.

segments.source: — Nu-l testăm, răspunse una dintre partenere. Numai observăm.
segments.translation: “We are not testing him,” one of the partners replied. “Only observing.”

segments.source: — Observarea schimbă felul în care îl atingeți.
segments.translation: “Observation changes the way you touch him.”

segments.source: — Și tu îl observi medical.
segments.translation: “And you observe him medically.”

segments.source: Vessa nu avea un răspuns curat. Medicina și cultura priveau același copil cu intenții diferite și îl modelau amândouă.
segments.translation: Vessa had no clean answer. Medicine and culture looked at the same child with different intentions, and both shaped him.

segments.source: — Îl pierdem, îi spuse lui Taren.
segments.translation: “We are losing him,” she told Taren.

segments.source: — Nu a fost niciodată al nostru.
segments.translation: “He was never ours.”

segments.source: — Nu ca fiu. Ca posibilitate.
segments.translation: “Not as a son. As a possibility.”

segments.source: Sen credea în Cod. Îl recita perfect, îi pedepsea pe cei care ucideau după predare și împărțea hrana patrulei la fel. Credea și că Fețele erau singurii adulți adevărați ai lumii, fiindcă numai ele acceptau riscul. Când un reprezentant civil îl contrazicea, îl asculta frontal și apoi executa ordinul Custodiei.
segments.translation: Sen believed in the Code. He recited it perfectly, punished those who killed after surrender and divided the patrol’s food equally. He also believed the Faces were the world’s only true adults, because only they accepted risk. When a civilian representative contradicted him, he listened face-on, then carried out the Custodianship’s order.

segments.source: Era mai disciplinat decât Taren, mai puțin crud în gesturi și mult mai periculos în convingeri.
segments.translation: He was more disciplined than Taren, less cruel in his gestures and far more dangerous in his convictions.
